gbm_population_evidence.quote: Integrating Biology for Safe Intensification of Glioblastoma Hypofractionated Treatment on the MR-Linac
Have histologically confirmed, newly diagnosed high grade glioma (histologic grade 3 or 4, IDH wildtype)

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a phase 1 study to examine the safety and tolerability of biology-guided dose intensified hypofractionated radiation therapy (RT) using MR-Linac for patients with high grade glioma (HGG).
Temozolomide (75 mg/m2) is administered daily throughout the 3 weeks of treatments and stopped on the final day of radiation therapy.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Have histologically confirmed, newly diagnosed high grade glioma (histologic grade 3 or 4, IDH wildtype)

role_evidence.quote: concurrent Temozolomide (75 mg/m2) will administered daily throughout the 3 weeks of treatments and stopped on the final day of RT.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent; standard concurrent chemoradiation backbone

source_quote.quote: Prior evidence of IDH mutation by IHC or DNA sequencing (i.e., IDH wild type only)

coder_notes: The investigational question is dose-intensified hypofractionated MR-Linac radiotherapy; temozolomide is standard concurrent backbone at a standard daily dose, so no pharmacological candidate (could alternatively be labelled established_therapy_only; either way excluded at S6). Population is grade 3 or 4 IDH-wildtype high-grade glioma; glioblastoma is named only in the title, so coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named. Gadolinium mentioned only in exclusion criteria and not a registered intervention, so not listed.
